answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Every claim climbs the atlas of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the saffron re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, revoked by a single upheld challenge, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the summit of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
